Commentary.Commentary: That's it from our side for this match. Not quite sure what Ireland have in store for them in the near future but Afghanistan will be playing in the Asia Cup nextup. To catch more cricketing action you can switch tabs to the England vs India game. Hope to have your company the next time around. Till then, have fun and stay healthy. Tata, bye-bye, ciao and sayonara!

Afghanistan captain, Asghar Afghan says he is proud of the way his team played, especially his bowlers. Adds that he is proud of the wicket he took but gives all the credit to his fielders and his bowlers. Ends by thanking the support they got throughout the tour.

Ireland captain, William Porterfield says that it wasn't a wrong decision to bat first but a wrong total. Assets that it's always difficult against such a bowling line-up. Adds that in the first two matches, they managed to make it even but in the last one, it was too much to be done. Implies that he is proud of the boys and the way they played. Ends by saying that they did not have much cricket in between so he is looking forward to the upcoming tournaments.

Player of the series, Rashid Khan starts by thanking the almighty. Adds that it was quite tough for him in the second match but he wanted to come back nicely and get the results in the third one on a difficult track. Further adds that the weather has been great and he really enjoyed cricket here. Ends by saying that he is hopeful of coming back again and playing in this beautiful country.

The visiting side though, showed just why the cricketing world is so excited about the progress of this wonderful set of players. Ihsanullah, in particular, was the shining star for the tourists as he held fort from start to end with an unbeaten 57. His partnerships with Shah and Shahidi ensured they cruise past the finishing line with ease. Ireland, on the other hand, were not up to the mark in this game but they will hope to learn some important lessons from this tour and will look to raise their game in their future tournaments.

Afghanistan will be more than happy with their performance. Their bowlers were right on the button as they just did not allow the Irish batsmen to settle in and put up a decent enough score. Their bowlers shared five apiece, were just too good for the hosts. Rashid Khan, in particular, was in his elements as he mesmerized the hosts with his guile and skill, picking up three wickets in the process. After restricting Ireland to a paltry total of 124, only a miracle or some hara-kiri from the Afghans could have saved the home team.

That is domination of the highest level by the Asian team. Afghanistan have chased this down with 26.1 overs and 8 wickets remaining. They finish the tour on a high. Though the home team showed good fighting spirit by bouncing back in the last game, the visitors were back to their best. They displayed a clinical performance in the third ODI to bag the series after sweeping the home team away in the T20Is.

FOUR! GAME...SET...and MATCH! A comprehensive and deserving win for the visiting team, they have dominated this match. McBrine pulls the length a bit short, Shahidi rocks back quickly and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary. This pair of Shahidi and Ihsanullah have chased this down in a canter.
Tossed up on off, Shahidi gets forward and defends. Anti-climax per se.
Leans forward again and turns it away to the mid-wicket region to reduce magin by a run.
Very full on middle and leg, Ihsanullah leans forward and turns it away to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on off is driven to mid on.
Chase lands this length ball outside off, Shahidi has nothing to do with it.
Full and on the stumps, is driven towards mid off for yet another single.
Short again from over the wicket. It's angled into Shahidi's ribs. He gets on his toes and tucks it away towards the fine leg region for a single.
Shahidi takes on the short ball again, tries to pull again but does not connect anywhere near as good as the first ball. No run.
A bit short outside off, Shahidi shoulders arms.

FOUR! Masterful stroke! Chase bangs it short just outside off, Shahidi picks up the length early, swivels and pulls it exquisitely towards the deep square leg region. The timing and placement carries the ball over the ropes.

Misfield! Shahidi cleverly guides the slow, shortish ball through the backward point region. Kevin there misfields and allows the batsmen take three. 9 more needed now or I should, just a formality left to be done.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stays put in his crease and keeps the flighted ball to the on side.

That's the highest score in the ODIs for Janat now, beating his previous best of 54 against Zimbabwe earlier this year. He gets a shortish ball around off and he gets it through the off side to reach his milestone.
FOUR! The difference between the two sides is visible here. Andy bowls a loopy ball on middle and off, Janat sweeps it up and over the square leg region and gets another boundary.
Flatter delivery in line of the stumps, defended.
Outside off, left alone.
HALF CENTURY FOR IHSANULLAH! Fine knock. Albeit, it was not under pressure. Gets to the landmark with a gentle push to the leg side.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man.
FOUR! Another short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Another long hop, but good bounce, Shahidi hops and pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
On a length outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Beaten! Tosses this up on the off stump. The ball dips, grips and turns across Shahidi who is looking to defend but gets beaten and survives.
McBrine strays on his pads and Ihsanullah flicks it for a single.
McBrine drops it short, Ihsanullah goes back and punches it to covers.
Ihsanullah flicks this full ball towards square leg for a single.

McBrine drops it a bit shorter outside off, McBrine goes back and across and open the face of the bat at the last moment, the balls flies through the third man region. The fielder at short third man chases it down and keeps them to three. Hundred comes up for Afghanistan. Just 25 runs remain now.
A bit shorter this from McBrine, Shahidi cuts this to the fielder at point.
A shortish ball again outside off, Shahidi stays back, gets on his toes and punches it through covers for a single.
On a length outside off, Shahidi punches it to the cover region.
Wide! The bouncer is way over the batsman's head. Too high infact, given a wide.
Chase gets a bit straighter and fires it on Shahidi's pads who flicks it but cannot find the gap at square leg.
Shahidi punches this short of a length ball straight to covers.
Keeps it on a length outside off. Shahidi lets it go.

Chase bangs it in short and Ihsanullah takes him on. He swivels and pulls it over the fielder at square leg. But has not timed it perfectly. The fielder at square leg chases it down and saves a run for his team.
A fine sweep again from the batsman but couldn't beat the diving Rankin at short fine leg. He though couldn't make the stop cleanly and hence, two runs are taken off the misfield.
A touch short around off, cut to backward point for no run.
FOUR! Shahidi turns this flighted ball into a low full toss and sweeps it clinically through the backward square leg  region. Afghan and Shahidi cruising along nicely.
Shahidi has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Similar line and drift from Andy, Shahidi pushes it back to the bowler for no run.
Floated around middle and leg, blocked off the front foot.
Andy McBrine comes back for another spell.
On a length around off, defended.

FOUR! And another beauty of a shot. I'm starting to like this young man and his mature shot making. He gets a similar ball to 16.3 and he makes sure that he doesn't miss out on a scoring opportunity. Ireland have given up it seems. No real effort from them is visible here.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
FOUR! Nice and easy! A touch of class there. A length ball outside off. Janat square cuts it through the cover-point region and takes a boundary on offer. It's all too easy right now.
Similar line and length from Murtagh, Janat pushes it to the on side.
Length ball on off, pushed to short mid-wicket for no run.
A bit shorter, angling into the batsman. Shahidi tries to work it into the leg side, gets beaten and is rapped on the thigh pads.
Full and straight, driven straight to mid off.

FOUR! This would ease off some pressure. Rankin keeps it very full on the stumps. Shahidi this time leans forward and drives this beautifully straight down the ground between the bowler and mid on. The mid on fielder gives chase but cannot stop it from rolling over the ropes.
Beaten! Loose shot by Shahidi.  Rankin lands it a bit shorter of a length. Shahidi goes for the square cut but the ball stays a bit low and goes under his bat.
Rankin strays on his pads and Janat turns this one into the on side towards square leg for a single.
Rankin continues with a full ball in line with the stumps. Janat stays back and keeps it out.
Around off, back of a length, worked through covers for run. He will keep the strike for the next over.
FOUR! Janat is looking so good against the short length balls here. He tucks this one over the mid-wicket region and to the boundary.
Length ball on off, driven to mid off.
Janat goes across to flick it through the on side but misses. The ball goes to the keeper to his left and an appeal is followed. The umpire ignores it.
Defended off the front foot by Ihsanullah presenting the full face of the bat.
Another short ball from TIm, Janat half-pulls it through the mid-wicket region and takes a couple.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
A length ball angled across the left-hander, he guides it to third man for no run.

Geez! That missed everything there. Another skiddy ball from Rankin this time. Shahidi hangs back waiting for the short ball perhaps and due to his weight on the back foot, he couldn't come forward in time to get his bat down. The ball cuts him in half and whizzes past his pad, bat and later, the sticks as well. Rankin can't believe how it happened. Shahidi survives a scare.
On the pads, flicked to the on side for no run.
FOUR! Nicely times this straight drive down the ground. A full ball in line of the stumps. Shahidi presents the full face and gets it past the bowler for a boundary.

Is that out? No, says the umpire. It looked to be hitting outside the off stump. Anyway, Tim hurls this one on a length and pushes it into Janat. The ball skids off the surface and the batsman is late to get his bat down. As a result, the ball raps him on his knee roll. The good thing here was he was hit outside the off stump line, which perhaps saved him.
Shortish around off, punched off the back foot through the off side. The batsmen changes strike.
Full ball on off, driven to mid off by Shahidi.
Angled across the left-hander who lets it be.
On a length around off, driven to mid off for no run again.
Shahidi lunges forward and keeps it out off the front foot for no run.

SIX! Pulls the trigger and Bang! What. A. Hit! Right off the screws. A half tracker from Rankin with not a lot of pace on it. Janat lines it up nicely, swivels and pulls it over the deep backward square leg fielder for a maximum. The best part was, the sound it made off the bat. Soothing to the ears, I tell you.
A surprising full toss for Janat in line of the stumps. He wasn't expecting it therefore he defended it nicely to the on side.
Rankin looking to target the blockhole. Janat works it to mid on with an angled bat.
On the middle stump, played to the on side for nothing.
Targets the off pole with a length ball to which Janat presents a full face and keeps it out.
Shortish ball outside off, played to point.
Boyd Rankin to share the attack from the other end.
Angled across the left-hander, he leaves it for the keeper. That's the end of the over, a successful one.
On a length around off, punched to covers for no run.
Almost a yorker to start with. Shahidi digs it to the on side. Two runs are taken.

The chase is about to resume after the Lunch break. Both the set of players are out in the middle. Janat, along with Hashmatullah Shahidi, will continue the progression. Tim Murtagh will finish his over. Here we go again...

So, the mini session comes to an end with Murtagh taking a wicket for Ireland. After Rankin's first wicket off the second over of the innings, the duo of Janat-Shah stitched a 50-run stand and charged along nicely. They kept the home team bowlers at bay and played some glorious shots in the process. They just need 72 more runs to wrap up this match and the series. They still have 8 wickets in hand  and it's shouldn't be too much of a worry. Though, Ireland wouldn't make it easy for them either. The chase continues after the break, hang around!

OUT! Timely wicket for the hosts. Tim Murtagh strikes right at the stroke of Lunch. The Irish team still in the hunt as they return back to their dressing room with some momentum and hope. Tim lands this one on a fuller length just outside off. Rahmat, while looking to half-heartedly come forward, tries to work it away towards mid-wicket. The ball pitches, nips in, beats the inside edge and hits Shah's front pad. The hosts go up with a big appeal and Ian Gould obliges. Can the home team fight back after the break and make a match out of this one?
Lands this a bit fuller around off, Shah lunges forward and keeps it out.
Keeps it a bit on the shorter side on middle and off, Rahmat stays back in his crease and defends with a straight bat.
Flighted on middle and off, driven through mid on for a run. 50-run stand is up between the duo. They have looked so pleasing to the eyes and have scored runs with so much ease.
Comes down the track to smother any spin on it. Gets to it easily and defends it.
Pushes this one on middle and off, blocked.
Rocks back and keeps the slower short ball away from his body.
Shortish in line of the stumps, pushed through the on side off the back foot for a run.
Slower ball around off, Janat defends it off the back foot.
Andy McBrine is into the attack now.

FOUR! And again, this one is the best of the lot. Another full ball in line of the stumps, Shah hits it through the line and gets it past the mid off fielder. No stopping after that as he collects back-to-back boundaries. Afghanistan marching forward with ease. 50 up for the visitors as well with it.

FOUR! Gorgeous this. What a pick up shot. Shah looking in sound form today. He gets a full ball ball on his pads and he flicks it nonchalantly over the square leg region for second boundary of the over.
Shortish around off, punched off the back foot to the off side for no run.
On the pads once again, Shah fails to get bat on ball and gets hit on his pads. It's down the leg side so no problem for the batting team here.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
FOUR! Cracking cover drive from Shah. No half measures on this one and he gets it through covers for a boundary off the first ball off the over.

Afghanistan seems to have the luck on their side. A full ball from Rankin, looking to get an LBW. Shah is early in his shot and gets a leading edge on it. The ball goes into the cover region and three runs are taken.
On the pads, flicked through the leg side for a run.
Played to the point region by Ihsanullah.

FOUR! Short, wide and punished. Janat has been relentless in his shot-making in his innings so far. He gets a short ball with some room on offer. He cuts it hard and gets it through cover-point. The ball races to the fence in no time.
Back of a length ball in line of the stumps, Janat gets on his toes and keeps it down.
On a length on off, defended nicely.
Shah has punched the ball off the back foot.
Short ball around the helmet, Janat pulls it for another easy single through the on side.
Similar line and length, flicked through the on side for a run.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for no run.
Square cuts another short ball through cover-point and changes strike.
On a length around off, played to point for no run.
Peter Chase is the first change.
In line of the stumps, blocked. End of an exciting over.
In the air... but safe! Just manages to keep it away from the left out stretched hand of the fielder at point. A shortish ball outside off, Shah chops it from his crease and gets two but just.

FOUR! Boom! What a shot this and in so much control. It's never easy to keep the hook shot down but Shah managed to do that easily. A short ball around his grille, he gets into position quickly and gets the connection sweetly. The ball races to the square leg fence and Afghanistan on the march.
Around off, kept out watchfully.
Shows the full face to the length ball and keeps it out.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Almost caught by Tim there. Janat checks his straight drive and it goes aerially towards the right of the bowler in his follow-through. He gets a hand to it but it goes past him after that. No harm done in the end.
Shot! Bang! Similar shot but better connection this time. A fullish ball on off, Janat drives it uppishly again through the line and gets it to the long off fence for a maximum.

It looked like a certain six or a four but in the end, it was stopped just inside the ropes. A lofted drive which went higher then he would've liked. The ball goes over the bowler's head for a couple.
On a length around off, punched off the back foot through covers for a run.
Lunges forward to the full ball outside his off stump and gets it through cover-point for a couple.
Lunges forward and keeps it out off the front foot.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Some chin music for Ihsanullah, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Gets fuller around off, Janat drives it to covers.
Another short ball outside the off pole, Janat leaves it for the keeper.
Shortish around off again, kept out under his eyes with a straight bat.
A bumper and Janat ducks under it.
FOUR! Crisp! That's the word for this beautiful clip off the pads. Shah gets a fullish ball on his pads and he gets in good position to clip through the vacant square leg region.
Similar line and length from Tim, Shah is happy to defend it again. He seems to be in no hurry. Just biding his time out till the innings break it seems.
On a length around middle and off, defended.
Fullish outside off, driven to covers for no run.
In line of the stumps, flicked to the on side off the inner half of the bat for a brace.
Comes forward and keeps it out down the ground.
On a length around off, blocked off the front foot by Janat. End of a successful over for the Irish.
Janat has played it to the point region.
Straightish on the hips, Shah clips it to the on side and changes strike.
Similar line and length from Boyd, nicely defended off the back foot by Shah.
Shortish around off again, defended.
Rahmat Shah walks in at no. 3.

OUT! Gone! What a start for Ireland, just what the doctor ordered. Rankin digs this one around off and Shahzad goes hard at it from his crease. He ends up getting a thick edge of his willow on it and it goes aerially towards the third man fielder. Murtagh there cups it easily and disappointment for Afghans in the second over. They need more wickets if they are to defend this low total.
Boyd Rankin to bowl from the other end.
Fuller in length on middle, it is driven towards mid on.
Up and over! Full around off, Ihsanullah lofts it over covers and takes a brace.
Another length ball, the batsman keeps it out.
On off and a hint of swing away from the batsman. Ihsanullah guides it to point.
Back of a length on off, Ihsanullah guides it to point.
Afghanistan are underway straightaway! On a length around off, Shahzad pushes it towards covers and gets to the other end.

We are back. We're about to get underway with the Afghanistan innings. The players are out in the middle. Mohammad Shahzad and Ihsanullah Janat is the opening duo for them. Tim Murtagh will open the attack for the home team. Here we go...
